story.paragraph: A young girl with short dark hair holds her head with both hands, sweating with her eyes closed tightly while another person leans close to her. The scene shifts to an outdoor alleyway where the girl looks up in shock as a large shadow falls over her. Back in the initial setting, the girl opens her eyes, revealing a determined expression. Finally, an extreme close-up shows a creature with yellow skin, a large red beak, and a bloodshot eye opening its mouth and staring intensely.
story.summary: A young girl reacts with distress and determination in an indoor setting before looking up in shock in an alleyway, where a creature with a large beak is revealed.
